result.summary: The page renders cleanly overall, with no overlapping elements, broken images, or misaligned sections. The only findings are minor: a possibly missing avatar in the top-right corner and some low-contrast grey text. Clipped carousel items and the cut-off card at the bottom were excluded as intended features.

issues.description: The top-right profile button is an empty grey circle with only a red dot, so the user's avatar or icon appears to be missing. The red dot is also unexplained, with no visible notification count.
issues.suggestion: Show a user avatar or profile icon in the circle, and add a count or label to the notification badge so its meaning is clear.

issues.description: Several secondary text elements use light grey on white or light grey backgrounds, including the search placeholder, the delivery-fee lines, and the '(500+)' rating count. Their contrast may fall below WCAG AA guidance.
issues.suggestion: Darken these grey tones to meet at least a 4.5:1 contrast ratio against their backgrounds.
